Effective Date: January 1, 2026 • DPDP Act 2023 & GDPR Compliant

A. Zero-Tracking Public Access

EnglishVidya (`https://englishvidya.com`) par sabhi educational notes, 10-Level Grammar Ladder, 19,000+ bilingual dictionary words, aur Bihar Board study materials 100% open aur bina kisi forced login ke available hain. Hum kisi bhi public visitor ka personal browsing data track ya commercial brokers ko sell nahi karte.

B. Google OAuth 2.0 Privacy

Agar aap personal bookmarks, study notes (My Diary) save karne ya quiz scores sync karne ke liye Google Sign-In ka upyog karte hain, toh hum sirf aapka verified email address aur public display name fetch karte hain. Hum aapke contacts ya personal drive data ka access kabhi nahi maangte.

C. Personal Notes & Diary Privacy Guarantee

Aapki personal dictionary bookmarks aur self-study notes puri tarah encrypted hain. Website admins ya content creators aapke personal notes ko monitor ya alter nahi karte.

D. Cloudflare Infrastructure & Cookies

Website security, DDoS protection, aur fast global edge delivery ke liye Cloudflare CDN infrastructure ka upyog kiya jata hai jo anonymous network security telemetry process karta hai.

Last Updated: August 18, 2026

A. Permitted Educational Fair Use

EnglishVidya par uplabdh sabhi content students, shikshakon aur competitive exam candidates ke vyaktigat adhyayan (personal study) ke liye hai.

  • Aap revision ke liye notes, grammar formulas aur dictionary padh sakte hain aur personal print le sakte hain.
  • Humaare content, grammar formulas ya question banks ko bulk scrape karke kisi doosri commercial website par bechna ya republish karna kanoonan sakht mana hai.

B. Intellectual Property

Master Manikant Yadav dwara taiyar kiye gaye pedagogical frameworks, simplified notes, stylesheets aur software code copyright kanoon ke tahat sanrakshit hain.

C. Community Conduct

Comment sections ya discussion forums me kisi bhi tarah ki gaali-galoj, spam, ya abusive bhasha ka upyog karne par account turant block kar diya jayega.

Statutory Disclaimer under Information Technology Act, 2000

A. Educational Nature of Service

EnglishVidya ek swatantra (independent) educational portal hai jiska uddeshya Hindi-medium students ko English language aur board syllabus me madad karna hai.

B. Accuracy & Error Reporting

Hum content ko 100% accurate rakhne ke liye niyamit roop se review karte hain. Yadi kisi note ya answer key me typing error paya jata hai, toh aap hume Contact Page par report kar sakte hain, jise hum 24 se 48 ghante me theek karte hain.

C. No Official Government Affiliation

EnglishVidya Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) ya kisi sarkari aayog ka official affiliate nahi hai. Humaari study materials independent pedagogical expertise par aadharit hain.

FTC Guidelines & Google Publisher Policies Compliant

A. Server Maintenance via Ethical Ads

Website ke high-speed servers, bandwidth, aur domain kharche chalane ke liye hum Google AdSense aur contextually relevant affiliate links ka upyog karte hain.

B. Editorial Independence

Humaare educational notes, grammar rules, aur book recommendations kisi bhi sponsor ya advertiser se prabhavit nahi hote. Humaara primary motive hamesha student clarity hota hai.

Legal Jurisdiction: Supaul, Bihar, India
